alex: RC cut scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 PT — need owners for quickstart smoke (node/python), sampleapps sanity, and changelog final edit. Who can take?

maria: I can do node quickstart smoke. Will run tests tonight and post results.

sam: I'll take python quickstart and sampleapps smoke. ETA 8pm PT.

jen: I'm happy to own changelog final pass. Any special notes on format? Do we need the :warning: 'breaking changes' section?

alex: jen: just follow the template in docs repo, include deps and API changes. Add a short bullet for any sampleapp behavior diffs.

sam: smoke commands:
```bash
# from repo root
make quickstart-smoke NODE=14
python tests/smoke_quickstart.py --env rc
```

maria: ran node smoke — found minor readme mismatch in quickstart/setup.md line 42, opened PR #452. app still boots.

jen: I'll prep changelog draft in docs/changelog/draft-rc.md, pinging @pm-ali for review.

pm-ali: I can review changelog at 7am PT tomorrow. cc: eng-sre for any infra notes.

eng-sre-bot: Reminder: RC deploy window locks at 9:30 PT. Any hotfix PRs must be merged before lock. :warning:

alex: Great — checklist:
- node smoke: maria
- python/sampleapps: sam
- changelog: jen (pm-ali review)
- merge hotfixes before 9:30 PT
I'll post a final pulse 9:15 PT. Thanks y'all :rocket:

maria: noted. If I hit a blocker, will escalate here with logs.

sam: will post smoke logs to the thread and link PRs.

jen: draft done, pushed, link: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/789 — feedback welcome.

alex: perfect. closing loop unless something pops up.
